rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a hatching blastocyst and visible zona breach, but it overstates confidence about ICM and especially TE quality from this single partially obscured image and adds speculative debris/apoptosis details not clearly visible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, endometrium, sperm parameters, cycle history, and diagnosis discrepancy with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to morphology and patient factors; minor issues include somewhat over-quantified modifiers and strong conclusions from limited image data.

Mostly aligned on SET and no assisted hatching, but recommendations such as routine consideration of PGT-A at age 34, ERA/thrombophilia/immunologic workup, and some adjuncts go beyond standard evidence-based guideline support.

Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer management and contingency planning, though some suggested tests/interventions are more speculative than standard and could reduce clinical usefulness.
